discovery.title: The Big Discovery
discovery.blurb: Somebody finds something they were not looking for.
discovery.page_3: {who} felt {feeling} and picked it up very carefully.
discovery.page_4: Nothing was ever quite the same again.

rescue.title: The Rescue
rescue.blurb: Someone needs help. Someone shows up.
rescue.page_1: {who} heard a small cry coming from {where}.
rescue.page_2: Stuck in the mud was {what}, and it needed help.
rescue.page_3: It was hard work, but {who} was {feeling} enough to try.
rescue.page_4: They walked home together as the sun went down.

journey.title: The Long Way Home
journey.blurb: A trip that does not go to plan.
journey.page_1: {who} set off for {where} with {what} in a backpack.
journey.page_2: The path disappeared, and the sky turned dark.
journey.page_4: Home was closer than it had looked all along.

space_friend.title: My Space Friend
space_friend.page_1: One quiet morning, {name} heard a loud {sound} outside the window.
space_friend.page_2: In the garden sat a {colour} {animal} from the {place}, looking very lost.
space_friend.page_3: It was hungry, so {name} shared some {food} until it stopped shaking.
space_friend.page_4: They played all afternoon, and the {silly} {animal} promised to come back.

lost_thing.title: The Lost Thing
lost_thing.blurb: Something goes missing. You find it.
lost_thing.page_1: {name} looked everywhere, but the {colour} key was gone.
lost_thing.page_2: A {silly} {animal} said it had seen something shiny down by the {place}.
lost_thing.page_3: They searched together until they heard a small {sound} under a rock.
lost_thing.page_4: There it was. {name} said thank you and shared the last of the {food}.

brave_night.title: The Bravest Night
brave_night.blurb: It is dark. You are braver than you think.
brave_night.page_1: The lights went out, and {name} did not feel brave at all.
brave_night.page_2: Then a {colour} {animal} appeared and whispered, "Follow me to the {place}."
brave_night.page_3: Every time {name} felt scared, they said the magic word: {sound}!
brave_night.page_4: By morning {name} knew something new: being {silly} and scared can happen at once.
